title: Valid Parentheses
problemStatement: Given a string s containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', and ']', determine whether the input string is valid. A string is valid if: Every opening bracket has a corresponding closing bracket of the same type. Brackets are closed in the correct order. Every closing bracket has a matching opening bracket. Return "true" if the string is valid; otherwise return "false".
output: true if the string is valid, otherwise false.
